repository.name: @webex/plugin-webhooks
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.webhooks that manages Webex webhook registrations through the Webex REST API webhooks resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs a webhook, get takes a webhook object or id and resolves one webhook, list resolves a webex-core Page, remove DELETEs a webhook and resolves undefined on a 204, and update PUTs the whole webhook object. Each call sends one request through webex.request and resolves what the service returns; the plugin checks no argument, does not receive or verify webhook deliveries, emits no SDK event, and caches or persists nothing.

webhooks-public-sdk.summary: Published npm package (public plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it registers Webhooks as public plugin 'webhooks' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default Webhooks class. webex.webhooks exposes create, get, list, remove, and update and nothing else (no SDK events, no delivery receiver); specified in src/docs/README.md.

hydra-webhooks-http.source: Webex REST API webhooks resource (catalog service name hydra, reached through service: 'hydra' in src/webhooks.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
hydra-webhooks-http.summary: POST /webhooks with a webhook body; GET /webhooks/<id>; GET /webhooks/ with the caller's query object answering a paged {items} with Link headers; DELETE /webhooks/<id> answering 204; PUT /webhooks/<id> with the whole webhook body. A webhook carries id, resource, event, filter, targetUrl, name, and created per the JSDoc typedef; the Webhook assertion of @webex/test-helper-chai expects a Hydra id and string resource, event, filter, targetUrl, and name. The service then POSTs each matching event to targetUrl; that delivery never passes through this package.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-013, MOD-014, MOD-048, UC-004)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerPlugin keys a public plugin by its raw name (webhooks, first registration wins) and adds webex.<name> to later instances; WebexPlugin supplies webex and request; a failed request rejects with a WebexHttpError whose message names the method, service, and resource.

webex-core-page.summary: new Page(res, webex) stores the body items and parsed Link headers; next and previous request the linked URL and resolve a new Page; hasNext and hasPrevious report the links; length and iteration follow items.
